rdfs:label: description
rdfs:comment: An account of the resource — a free-text description.
notes: Free-text account of the resource. For a formal abstract (papers, specs) use `urn:solid:abstract`; for a short AS2-style summary use `urn:solid:summary`. Not `urn:solid:comment` (schema:comment = a reply/comment object). Repeat with language tags for translations. ical:description is related but component-scoped (RFC 5545), so it is listed under seeAlso rather than sameAs.

jsonld.urn:solid:description: An introduction to the urn-solid registry and how to use it.

history.note: Promoted schema:description from seeAlso to owl:sameAs and added ical:description — same free-text-description predicate across all three vocabularies.
Rewrote notes to disambiguate abstract/summary/comment; moved ical:description from owl:sameAs to rdfs:seeAlso.
